context: Sho tells Grandpa about a walk in the neighborhood.
purpose: Casual home register reusing stragglers (入る/道路/ファン/とにかく/どうも) naturally.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: おじいちゃん、公園に入ってきたよ!
lines.en: Grandpa, I went into the park!
lines.style: bright small child voice, warm excited bouncing delivery throughout

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.jp: ほう、道路は気をつけたかね?
lines.en: Oh, were you careful on the road?
lines.style: gravelly old man voice, soft warm gentle caring delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん、道路の端を歩いたよ。
lines.en: Yeah, I walked on the edge of the road.
lines.style: proud small child voice, warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.jp: えらいぞ。どうも最近、車が多いからな。
lines.en: Good boy. Somehow there are many cars lately.
lines.style: gravelly old man voice, soft warm approving delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 公園で、電車のファンの子に会ったよ!
lines.en: In the park I met a kid who's a train fan!
lines.style: excited small child voice, warm bubbly delivery throughout

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.jp: ほう、君も電車のファンじゃろ?
lines.en: Oh, you're a train fan too, aren't you?
lines.style: gravelly old man voice, soft warm amused delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: とにかく、電車が大好きなんだ!
lines.style: enthusiastic small child voice, warm eager delivery throughout

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.jp: とにかく、また道路に気をつけてな。
lines.en: Anyway, watch the road again next time.
lines.style: gravelly old man voice, soft warm caring closing delivery throughout
